findings.text: follow-on: the fragment (and the test module docstring) say the meeting sits 'after each writer's own read and version check, before either takes the lock', but _store._write_state acquires the per-file lock at _store.py:1193 and the version check runs inside _write_state_locked under that lock, so the meeting is before the version check, not after it. The race is still real (both writers reach the meeting; the lock then decides which proceeds and which meets the conflict/merge path), so this is a claim-accuracy defect in the prose, not a functional one. The placement precision does not affect the node's done-when.
